title: Jesus' Birth
description: Jesus is born in Bethlehem and laid in a manger. Angels announce the good news to the shepherds, and wise men from the East come to worship him.

versions.reason: [minor] references: Existing story 'wise-men-from-the-east' covers Matthew 2:1-12. This story includes both the Luke account and the Matthew wise men, so there is overlap that should be handled with a merge.
